purpose: Teach: 多少なりとも/殊に/ドロドロ/帰り際/頷い/はおり/わきまえ/大人しく

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、多少なりともお祖父ちゃんの役に立ちたいわね
lines.en: Sho, it'd be nice if you could be helpful to Grandpa, even in small ways.
lines.style: Warm and gentle, almost thinking aloud. Slight lift of hope on 'be helpful.' Tender but not saccharine—a mother noticing her son's capacity to care.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんの背中が殊に大きく見えたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad's back looked really big to me today.
lines.style: Quiet, genuinely observant. Not seeking reassurance—just sharing what he noticed. Slow, wondering pace. The tone of a child noticing something adults don't always see.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、外がドロドロでお靴汚れちゃうわね
lines.en: Sho, you'll get your shoes all muddy out there.
lines.style: Light, wry amusement underneath. Matter-of-fact but with a hint of fondness. A practical concern wrapped in gentle skepticism—she knows he'll go anyway.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お祖父ちゃんが帰り際にお小遣いくれたよ
lines.en: Mom, Grandpa gave me some allowance when he was leaving.
lines.style: Bright, matter-of-fact happiness. Quick pace. The simple satisfaction of a small gift received and remembered. No dramatizing—just pleased.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがお祖父ちゃんに頷いてらしたわね
lines.en: Sho, your dad was nodding at Grandpa, wasn't he?
lines.style: Gentle, reflective observation. Quiet curiosity—not quite a question. Noticing a moment of connection between father and grandfather. Thoughtful trailing tone.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お祖母ちゃんのはおりが暖かかったよ
lines.en: Mom, Grandma's haori was so warm.
lines.style: Bright, genuine warmth in the memory. Quick, eager—the kind of child-observation that bubbles up unprompted. Soft contentment at the end, like the feeling of that fabric.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お友達同士、礼儀をわきまえて遊びましょう
lines.en: Sho, when you're with friends, you should mind your manners and play nicely.
lines.style: Gentle but clear guidance. Not lecturing—offering direction with warmth. A mother's quiet expectation, firmly held but delivered without tension.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お祖父ちゃんの前では大人しくしてたよ
lines.en: Mom, I was quiet and well-behaved when Grandpa was here.
lines.style: Quiet pride, genuine and unselfconscious. A child pleased with himself without needing fanfare. Steady tone—not seeking praise, but subtly proud of the effort.
